items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Just before John Schlesinger, who’s the director, said, “Action,” Vanessa said to me... We did it, and it was fine.

ctx.x: Okay. Creative writing student. When I see that description – Yanks was one of the early ones. It listed you – in 1979 – listed you as the Red Cross lady.

With Vanessa Redgrave. I don’t drive. I can drive, but not in traffic. So I only drive in movies and t.v. There was a scene where Vanessa and I are in a jeep. We have to go down this road, and we suddenly come across a huge area which is showers, and the guys are naked. Just before John Schlesinger, who’s the director, said, “Action,” Vanessa said to me, “I’m told you don’t drive.” I said, “That’s right” – rrrrrrrrr. We did it, and it was fine. Then John said, “We’re going to have to take another angle.” I said,…
